TextView.android:text: Full manual
Everything AudPlayer can do, section by section. Open the More (•••) panel from the bottom navigation for most tools.
1) Playing music

- Tap any song in the list to play it.
- Swipe up/down on the mini player to expand or collapse the full now-playing controls. Tap the expand arrow for the same.
- Use play/pause, next/previous, and the seek bar. The two buttons beside the seek bar skip forward/backward by your Seek Time setting.
- Playback keeps running in the background with notification controls. The notification's close button stops playback and exits.
- Mode button: choose Repeat Current, Next in List (plays the list in order), or Random.
- Tap the music icon in the player to jump the list to the currently playing song.
2) Library, folders, search and sort

- Toggle between the all-songs list and folder view using the folder/list icon in the bottom navigation.
- Search filters songs instantly. If a song seems missing, clear the search filter first.
- Sort by name, date, size, or duration (ascending or descending) from the Sort option.
- Refresh re-scans your music. Browse opens the system file picker so you can open any audio file directly.
- Settings > Auto slide to current song keeps the playing track visible in the list.
3) File options

Open a song's options menu to:
- File details: shows format, size, duration and location. Tap the path text to copy it to the clipboard.
- Rename and Delete files.
- Share a file with other apps.
- Add to playlist.
4) Playlists

- Open Playlists from the bottom navigation, then create a new playlist.\n- Add songs using each song's options menu (Add to playlist).\n- Open a playlist to play its songs in sequence. Long-press or use its menu to rename or delete it.
5) Equalizer and boost

- Equalizer: drag the band sliders to shape the sound, or pick a preset (device presets and custom presets like Rock, Pop, Jazz).\n- Boost: raises volume up to 5x using a loudness enhancer. Quick chips set common values.
6) Voice Changer

Open Voice Changer from the More panel. Sliders and toggles apply live while music plays:
- Pitch: raise or lower the voice pitch (0.25x–4x), with quick chips.
- Formant: shifts the voice character without changing speed.
- Speed: playback speed (0.25x–4x).
- Bass / Reverb: deepen the low end, add room ambience.
- Treble: boost or cut high frequencies.
- Vocal Clarity: lifts speech frequencies and reduces muddiness.
- Echo: adds repeated reflections.
- Distortion: metallic, aggressive tone.
- Vibrato: periodic pitch wobble.
- Volume Boost: up to 3x volume (synced with the Boost tool).
- Voice Depth: deeper on one side, thinner on the other.
- Robot: synthetic, metallic voice effect (toggle).
- Noise Reduction: suppresses background noise (toggle; depends on device support).
- Auto-tune: snaps the pitch to exact musical semitones (toggle; pauses vibrato while on).
- Voice Presets: one-tap voices such as Monster, Chipmunk, Alien, Ghost and more.
- EQ Presets: voice-tuned curves (Male, Female, Deep, Radio...).
- Each slider has a reset icon; Reset All Voice Settings restores every control at once.
All settings are saved and reapplied automatically on the next song.
7) Mixer mode (dual track)

- Enable Mixer mode to play a second track alongside the primary one.\n- Select second audio, adjust left/right balance, sync track positions, and enable individual speeds for each track.\n- Save mixer setups and reload them later from Saved mixers. Clear second audio to return to single-track playback.
8) A-B Repeat
Set a Point A and Point B in a song, then enable to loop just that section. Clear removes both points.
9) Sleep timer
Set 15/30/45/60 minutes or a custom time. When the timer ends the app can pause playback or close completely (choose the end action).
10) Settings

- Theme: White, Bluish Black, Milky, or Custom color.
- Seek Time Settings: change how many seconds the skip buttons jump (1–300s).
- Play alongside other apps: keep playing when other apps start audio.
- Auto slide to current song.
- Reset Options: choose which settings reset when you use Reset (speed, pitch, equalizer, boost).
- Exit App: fully stops playback and closes the app (same as the notification's close button).
11) Tips and troubleshooting

- If no songs appear, refresh the list and check that media/storage permission is granted.
- If a song you just picked is not in the list, clear the search filter or check folder view.
- Voice Changer and Equalizer effects apply to the current song's audio session; effects are remembered between songs.
- Noise Reduction and some effects depend on your device's audio engine; if a device doesn't support one, the app tells you and everything else keeps working.
- Use saved mixers for quick repeat dual-track setups.
